This is DAQP 0.10.2 from https://github.com/darnstrom/daqp at the revision
recorded in `UPSTREAM_COMMIT`. The C sources and headers are copied verbatim.
They are licensed under the terms in `LICENSE`.

The Drake adapter is in `solvers/daqp_solver.cc`. The bundled source keeps the
solver available in builds without a separately installed DAQP library.
